title: a13n Service usage
description: Runs and model usage per tenant, read from the Service's PostgreSQL facts. Use a read-only database role.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', r.created_at) AS time, r.status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM runs r
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', u.ingested_at) AS time,
  sum((u.record->'request_usage'->>'input_tokens')::bigint) AS input_tokens,
  sum((u.record->'request_usage'->>'output_tokens')::bigint) AS output_tokens
FROM usage_records u
WHERE u.record->>'kind' = 'model' AND $__timeFilter(u.ingested_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', r.created_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT r.workspace_id) AS workspaces
FROM runs r
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.name AS organization, w.name AS workspace, count(*) AS runs,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'completed') AS completed,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed') AS failed,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled
FROM runs r
JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = r.workspace_id
JOIN organizations o ON o.id = r.organization_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
GROUP BY o.name, w.name
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Model usage by workspace and model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.name AS organization, w.name AS workspace, coalesce(m.key, 'unattributed') AS model,
  count(*) AS requests,
  sum((u.record->'request_usage'->>'input_tokens')::bigint) AS input_tokens,
  sum((u.record->'request_usage'->>'output_tokens')::bigint) AS output_tokens,
  sum((u.record->'request_usage'->>'cost')::numeric) AS cost
FROM usage_records u
JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = u.workspace_id
JOIN organizations o ON o.id = u.organization_id
LEFT JOIN models m ON m.id = u.model_id
WHERE u.record->>'kind' = 'model' AND $__timeFilter(u.ingested_at)
GROUP BY o.name, w.name, m.key
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.description: Cost sums each record's priced cost; records without a price count tokens only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.failure->>'code' AS reason, count(*) AS runs, count(DISTINCT r.workspace_id) AS workspaces
FROM runs r
WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY runs DESC
